q: The Multibrot set M_d (the analogue of the Mandelbrot set for f_c(z) = z^d + c) satisfies: c ∈ M_d iff the orbit of the critical point 0 is bounded. For d even, M_d is:
opts: Has d−1 'buds' around the main cardioid
Has the same shape as M₂
exp: The Multibrot set M_d is connected (as the Mandelbrot set M₂), homeomorphic to M₂ for d ≥ 2. For d odd, the boundary consists of d-1 main components. For all d, M_d is simply connected. The self-similarity and topology of M_d parallel those of M₂.
